Specification: 3 stages, like the best long-life purifiers: DebrisGuard (washable debris catcher) -> LifeHEPA 5-year H13 -> OdourCore carbon

4 magnetic washable panels of 60-mesh (250 um) PET mesh around the filter. Catches hair, lint, pet fur, coarse dust so they never reach the HEPA. Rinse under a tap every 2-4 weeks, dry 2 h. Lifetime part; spare set INR 499
H13 (99.95 % at MPPS, EN 1822) glass-fibre mini-pleat, 60 mm deep, 4 mm pitch, 400 x 400 x 480 mm square tube. Media area 23 m2 (about 20 x a normal flat HEPA). Retail INR 5,999, about every 5 years
1.4 kg coconut-shell activated carbon + MnO2 catalyst (formaldehyde) in a sleeve inside the HEPA. Retail INR 799, about every 12 months (gas load decides)
700 m3/h / 23 m2 = 0.85 cm/s (normal HEPA: 3-5 cm/s), so pressure drop is low (~80 Pa new) and the fan stays quiet
DebrisGuard ~5 Pa + LifeHEPA ~80 Pa + OdourCore ~50 Pa = ~135 Pa at 700 m3/h
When fan power at Turbo rises 25 % (EC fan holds airflow) or CADR would fall below 80 % - stricter than the common 50 % CADR rule
23 m2 x 40 g/m2 (conservative H13 holding to end of life) = about 920 g
28 m2 room, 12 h/day, 3 air changes/h leakage (typical Indian home), city annual PM10 up to 180 ug/m3
Firmware counts real dust (PM sensor x airflow) and fan-power rise; app shows % left and the date it expects to need a change
LifeHEPA 1 x 5,999 + OdourCore 4 x 799 = INR 9,195 (vs INR 3,999 x 5 = 19,995 for a yearly filter)
DebrisGuard set INR 180-260; LifeHEPA INR 2,600-4,200; OdourCore INR 320-450
